# Plan a trip

1. Ask for the dates and the budget. Use the `budget` skill to set a daily limit.
2. Use the `book-flight` skill to buy the tickets.
3. Then follow [the packing list](../pack-bag/SKILL.md) for the bag.

Don't load `weather-check` here, since `book-flight` checks the weather.

The `budget` column in the trip sheet holds the daily limit.

When in doubt, ask the packer.
